Description: Epic for requirements work. Includes OHAMS-8 and OHAMS-9. Acceptance: requirements deliverable contains all user roles, FR-1 to FR-13, non-functional requirements, exclusions and chosen stack.
Epic for database and architecture hand-off H2. Includes OHAMS-10, OHAMS-11 and OHAMS-12.
Epic for backend hand-off H3. Includes OHAMS-13, OHAMS-14, OHAMS-15 and OHAMS-16. Depends on database contract and database helpers being ready.
Parent tracking epic for the shared frontend hand-off H4 and patient frontend work. Patient page implementation is tracked under OHAMS-17.
Epic for H7 integration and testing. Includes OHAMS-19 and OHAMS-20. Start integration only after backend, patient pages and doctor/admin dashboards are merged.
Parent tracking epic for H8 deployment. Includes OHAMS-21. Deployment is gated on successful integration and test/build checks.
Epic for project management documents and final submission pack. Includes OHAMS-22 to OHAMS-25.

Create docs/requirements.md covering purpose, patient/doctor/admin roles, FR-1 to FR-13, non-functional requirements and out-of-scope features. Acceptance: all required headings and functional requirement IDs are present and reviewed.

Document the selected Next.js 14, PostgreSQL/Neon, pg, JWT cookie authentication and Vercel stack, with rationale and one considered alternative. Acceptance: decision table matches the agreed project scope.

Summary: Create PostgreSQL schema and database helper
Description: Implement db/schema.sql and lib/db.js per docs/CONTRACT.md, including tables, relationships, constraints, indexes, query() and withTransaction(). Acceptance: schema initializes on a clean PostgreSQL database and helper signatures match the contract.

Summary: Write system architecture and appointment workflow
Description: Create docs/architecture.md with architecture diagram, component responsibilities, database relationships, booking/cancellation workflow and security notes. Acceptance: diagram and narrative match the implemented stack and shared contract.

Summary: Create database initialization and seed scripts
Description: Implement scripts/init-db.js and scripts/seed.js with demo admin, doctors, patient and tomorrow's sample slots. Ensure ON CONFLICT handling and repeatable seed execution. Acceptance: db:init and db:seed both run successfully twice without duplicate rows or errors.

Implement POST /api/appointments using withTransaction; validate slotId, atomically claim an unbooked slot, create BOOKED appointment and trigger patient/doctor notifications. Acceptance: duplicate or concurrent booking returns conflict and exactly one request succeeds; response follows CONTRACT.md.

Implement PATCH /api/appointments/:id/cancel with patient/doctor/admin authorization, cancellation status and timestamp, slot release and notifications. Acceptance: unauthorized cancellation is rejected; repeated cancellation returns the documented conflict response.

Implement createNotification(), GET /api/notifications and PATCH /api/notifications/read. Acceptance: only the logged-in user's notifications are returned, newest first, and mark-read updates unread rows.

Summary: Implement doctor listing and slot management APIs
Description: Implement GET doctors, GET doctor slots, GET/POST slots and DELETE slot routes with role and ownership checks. Acceptance: only future available slots are exposed to patients; doctors can manage only their own slots; response shapes and errors match CONTRACT.md.

Summary: Build patient pages and appointment flows
Description: Build landing, login, register, patient booking and patient appointments pages; integrate shared Navbar, NotificationList and api helper. Acceptance: patient can browse doctors, view free slots, book, view/cancel own appointments and see notifications; wrong-role access redirects to login.

Build /doctor and /admin pages using shared frontend helpers. Doctor can add/delete slots, view/cancel appointments and view notifications; admin can add doctors and view all doctors/appointments. Acceptance: role checks, loading/error states and API payloads follow CONTRACT.md.

Integrate merged patient, doctor and admin pages with backend routes; resolve API contract mismatches and role-specific flow defects. Dependency: H3, H5 and H6 changes merged to main. Acceptance: all three role journeys work against seeded PostgreSQL data and npm run build passes.

Summary: Run end-to-end test suite and prepare test report
Description: Execute README T1-T15, including simultaneous booking protection, record actual outcomes in docs/test-report.md, fix blockers and rerun failed cases. Acceptance: each test has actual result and PASS/FAIL; build check is recorded. Never mark a test PASS without executing it.

Summary: Deploy to Vercel and run production smoke tests
Description: After H7 passes, configure DATABASE_URL and JWT_SECRET in Vercel, deploy, initialize/seed production DB, smoke test login/booking/doctor/admin flows and record the real live URL in README. Acceptance: deployed app responds and key flows work; record any remaining limitations honestly.

Create docs/project/cost-estimation.md with estimation method, assumptions, effort table, notional labour rate, infrastructure assumptions, contingency and limitations. Label all financial values as estimates, not actual spend.

Summary: Prepare project schedule and Gantt chart
Description: Create docs/project/schedule.md with OHAMS-1 to OHAMS-26 plan, owners, planned dates, estimates, milestone sequence and Gantt view. Keep actual finish dates blank until work actually finishes; use this plan as planned dates only.

Summary: Prepare risk register and mitigation plan
Description: Create docs/project/risk-analysis.md with likelihood x impact scoring, mitigation actions and owners for booking race conditions, merge conflicts, contract mismatch, deployment config, secret exposure and schedule risk. Separate hypothetical risks from risks that actually occurred.

Summary: Compile final project report and contribution summary
Description: Create docs/project/final-report.md after test and deployment evidence are available. Include introduction, requirements, design, implementation, actual test results, deployment URL, project management documents, genuine issues and Git/Jira-based contribution summary. Draft structure on 25 Nov; finalize evidence on 26 Nov.

Summary: Initialize Next.js project and development environment
Description: Create Next.js 14 project skeleton, package scripts/dependencies, next.config.js, .env.example, .gitignore and base folders; run npm install and npm run dev; push H0 to main. Acceptance: teammate can clone, install and start the app without committing secrets.
